sourceFile: 8. BRS-201506 DT Report checking and test improve NG Function date 18.12.2024_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is not verified because it merges many distinct process/JIG/voltage tests into one ambiguous changed-factor case.
issues: Changed factor overgroups unrelated tests across many sheets.
Baseline and test conditions are mixed and sometimes reversed.
Subgroup keys include primary conditions instead of row-level context only.
Unknown Sheet1 and decap analysis are included without comparable change evidence.
Most outcomes are unjudged metric dumps, not verified comparisons.
correctionPlan: Split review cases by actual test context and sheet purpose.
Define one primary changed factor per case from content rows.
Pair baseline/test rows only within the same date/test/process context.
Remove non-comparable Sheet1 and decap-only analysis from evidence or make separate excluded/reference items.
Keep only cited rows that support each changed condition and outcome judgement.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are insufficient until grouping and comparable-pair evidence are corrected.
